name: amazon-commission-engine-dashboard
description: Builds the static dashboard from the latest report. The engine itself is Python; see README.md.

scripts.build: (python3 -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt || pip install -q -r requirements.txt || true) && python3 -m ace site --site-out dist --mirror build public out _site . || python -m ace site --site-out dist --mirror build public out _site .
